data.name: Isonade Test
data.description: Staff test only. The Isonade fight from The Flooded Stores, on its own: no chart, no crew fights, no rewards.

objectives.description: The storeroom is half sea now. What's left of the stores floats in black water, and something in the water is eating them.
The water heaves, and one pale eye opens in it.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the way back closes.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the way back closes behind you.

objectives.description: It lets go and slides back out through the crack in the hull.
The black water closes over you, and you wake on the sand.
